## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The save command should report write failures because users and callers currently receive a success result even when no report was created.

## Changes

The pull request adds a command that writes a generated report and announces its destination. It also adds cleanup for temporary reports and tests for both operations.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- app/reports.py:8 — silent-failure — Report failed writes as errors — Saving to `missing/report.txt` when the parent directory is absent prints a success message and returns `0`. The handler discards the `FileNotFoundError` raised by `write_text`. — When the destination directory is missing, users and callers can proceed believing the report exists. — Fix: Report the destination and write error, return a nonzero status, and extend `test_save_with_unavailable_destination`.
